live_availability.reason: SGENAXIS_MCP_LIVE_ENDPOINT unset at planning probe; IMPL-01 dispatch report absent

dependencies.decision_gap: stdio vs loopback HTTP + exact server/argv/tool + timeout/cancel bounds still owner-gated

field_defs.request: Secret-free call identity: transport kind, server_name, tool, args_digest (no raw secrets/tokens/credentials)
field_defs.result: Observable payload digest or typed error class; never raw endpoint credentials
field_defs.terminal: Exactly one terminal class per attempt: success | invalid_tool | reject | timeout | cancel | disconnect | not_run
field_defs.version: Binding: crate/feature/build or protocol negotiation revision used for the attempt

evidence_schema.claim_rule: Any Live PASS/FAIL claim must attach all four fields; missing field ⇒ evidence incomplete (not Live PASS)

prohibitions.fake_as_live: FakeMcpClient / in-process simulation is fixture-only; never recorded as Live smoke PASS
prohibitions.stub_as_live: StubMcpClient RealMcpDisabled proves unavailability, not Live transport
prohibitions.dry_run_as_live: DryRun AgentChunk stream is simulation; label Simulated, never Live
prohibitions.static_html_as_live: module.html / this matrix are design artifacts; opening them is not Live execution
prohibitions.auto_product_accept: Smoke outcomes never set product green or release acceptance

scenarios.name: success
scenarios.given: IMPL Live composition ready; activatable approved endpoint/tool; controlled harmless args
scenarios.when: One Live connect + approved call_tool completes within policy timeout
scenarios.then: terminal=success; request/result/terminal/version recorded; no product green

scenarios.name: invalidtool
scenarios.given: Live target configured; tool not on approved_tools (or server unknown tool)
scenarios.when: Live call_tool requested for the invalid tool
scenarios.then: terminal=invalid_tool; no successful tool result claim; secrets not echoed

scenarios.name: reject
scenarios.given: Unactivatable or policy-rejected target (empty/reserved) or Guard/host rejection before dial
scenarios.then: terminal=reject or not_run; no socket/stdio dial for forbidden targets

scenarios.name: timeout
scenarios.given: Live target that does not complete initialize/tool within approved bound (proposed 10_000ms until DEC locks)
scenarios.then: terminal=timeout; exactly one terminal; no auto-retry inventing success

scenarios.name: cancel
scenarios.given: An in-flight Live session under approved cancel policy (proposed disconnect/cancel bound 2_000ms)
scenarios.then: terminal=cancel; session closed best-effort; no force-kill of unrelated processes

scenarios.name: disconnect
scenarios.given: Open Live session then peer drop or explicit disconnect
scenarios.then: terminal=disconnect; subsequent call_tool cannot claim success on dead session

proposed_policy_from_dec_not_guarantees.note: PROPOSED values from DEC packet; not current runtime guarantees until IMPL + owner lock

gate_before_live_execution: PD-RUST-MCP-TRANSPORT-IMPL-01 delivers real McpClientPort composition (not Stub default alone)
Owner-approved explicit target (stdio argv or activatable loopback endpoint + tool)
probe_mcp_live_smoke_target() returns Some(...) or equivalent DEC-locked stdio probe
